attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as the router between lan-a (10.60.1.0/24, vtnet1/opt1, peer node2) and lan-b (10.60.2.0/24, vtnet2/opt2, peer node3). Added pf rules on both opt interfaces that block+log TCP/23 in either direction while passing all other traffic, and confirmed logged block entries in /var/log/filter/ for attempts from node2 and node3. All three nodes were restarted one at a time using native reboot mechanisms; boot identities changed on each and the block+log behavior plus general inter-LAN routing (ping) were re-verified after every restart.
